title: Input & Output
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Input & Output in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: input()
items.text: input() reads text entered by the user and returns it as a string.

items.heading: print()
items.text: print() sends values to the screen. It can display text, numbers and multiple values.

items.heading: Input is text
items.text: Even when a user types a number, input() initially returns a string.

items.heading: Convert input to int
items.text: Use int() when text input should become a whole number.

items.heading: Convert input to float
items.text: Use float() when a decimal number is required.

items.heading: Prompt text
items.text: A string passed to input() is shown as a prompt to tell the user what to enter.

items.heading: Displaying variables
items.text: A variable can be passed directly to print() to display its current value.

items.heading: Multiple values
items.text: print() can receive more than one value and separates them with spaces by default.

items.heading: Output formatting
items.text: f-strings provide a readable way to combine text and variable values.

items.heading: Simple input-output flow
items.text: A common beginner program reads data, converts it when needed, processes it and then prints the result.
